name: year
description: Ano inicial do exercício fiscal a que se referem os dados; 2023 corresponde ao exercício 2023-24
observations: Partition column. Derived from each source sheet's own title rather than from the release that ships it, because some tables cover a different financial year from their release
description_en: Start year of the financial year the data refer to; 2023 denotes the 2023-24 year
description_es: Año inicial del ejercicio fiscal al que se refieren los datos; 2023 corresponde al ejercicio 2023-24

name: sex
description: Sexo do contribuinte conforme registrado na declaração
description_en: Sex of the taxpayer as recorded in the return
description_es: Sexo del contribuyente según consta en la declaración

name: state_abbreviation
description: Sigla do estado ou território de residência do contribuinte
observations: Includes the non-geographic values 'Overseas' and 'Unknown', which have no directory match
description_en: Abbreviation of the taxpayer's state or territory of residence
description_es: Sigla del estado o territorio de residencia del contribuyente

name: broad_industry_code
description: Código da divisão industrial ampla (letra ANZSIC)
description_es: Código de la división industrial amplia (letra ANZSIC)

name: broad_industry
description: Nome da divisão industrial ampla da atividade principal do contribuinte
description_en: Name of the broad industry division of the taxpayer's main activity
description_es: Nombre de la división industrial amplia de la actividad principal del contribuyente

name: item
description: Item tributário declarado, conforme o rótulo da coluna na tabela de origem
observations: The set of items varies across years as the ATO adds or retires labels
description_en: Taxation item reported, as labelled by the column in the source table
description_es: Ítem tributario declarado, según la etiqueta de la columna en la tabla de origen

name: record_count
description: Número de registros com valor informado para o item
description_en: Number of records reporting a value for the item
description_es: Número de registros que declaran un valor para el ítem

name: amount
description: Valor monetário agregado do item, em dólares australianos
description_en: Aggregate monetary value of the item, in Australian dollars
description_es: Valor monetario agregado del ítem, en dólares australianos
